steps.task: Exact-head preflight: lock worktree to 1cb80e40f0f818389307aedeb14aaaceaa3e8ed1, clean status, PR #1176 open, record live blockers.
Remove the absolute worktree value from SOURCE_MANIFEST.json (no code path reads it; dropped rather than replaced with a fabricated repo-relative placeholder).

Replace the literal $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) in NORMALIZATION_REPORT.md with the concrete UTC generated_at timestamp emitted by the actual regeneration run of build_normalized_catalog.py for this repair.
Reorder test_generation_idempotent so builder --check runs against the committed catalog first, before any regeneration; keep a post-regeneration --check as an idempotency assertion.

Change the Claude regex group in _scan_model_ids to non-capturing and switch matching to finditer(...).group(0) so full matches (e.g. claude-sonnet-4.5) are returned instead of bare capture fragments (e.g. sonnet); add a focused regression test.
Regenerate config/commandcode/normalized_agent_persona_catalog.yaml and proof/CCAR-002/** implementation evidence honestly; verify source agent/persona hashes still match SOURCE_MANIFEST.json.
Commit R3 only on allowlisted evidence/test/packet paths; capture R3 SHA.
